name: tooltip-keyword
goal: Hover bubble (mockups infobulles v1: A1 parchment, T1 timing, K2 keyword cards, P0 beside the trigger): a real client holds the Mage Occulte (the host screen follows the bots it possesses and may hover a counter instead); at night the real-input tour rests the virtual mouse on a power object whose text has a keyword (Corruption Ciblée -> Concentration): the parchment bubble opens after the 0.3 s rest with the keyword card beside it (capture tour-tooltip, 0.2 s after the opening), and closes once the pointer leaves (GameLog ui.tooltip.open / ui.tooltip.close). Filmed at 30 fps with the bubble left 1.5 s on screen, for the fade in and out.
